why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft after report 529: copy by itself, chat font guard, plural escape, data

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Changed
- The copy buttons of the small page copy by themselves on a click when the client has a copy function (no Ctrl+C). Without one they select the text in the box as before.

Fixed (from the 27 Nov report)
- The chat font of a window (chat 1 and the combat log tab) went back and forth between the game's and ours in fights. When the game puts its own font back on a window that shows Persian, ours is set again at once.
- A tooltip time line with the client's plural escape ('51 minutes remaining') matched no row in the spell tooltips. It does now, and the rows for minutes, hours, seconds and days are in the data.

New texts
- Boosted Rest (the name and the Camp Tent line), the lines 'You feel rested.' and 'Only Reagents can be placed in Reagent Bags.', the NPC names Krix, Lieutenant Prenish, Powderfuse Bruiser and Sentry Gant.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- The trace and the timers in the report (to find why everything turns English after a temporary buff and why the addon feels heavy). A module that the circuit breaker switched off in a fight comes back after it.
- Small page of the icon, update and new tags, the buffs switch with a preview, the experimental combat option, the game windows switch OFF by default.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
